warnings: Prohlížeč neposkytl jednoznačný název grafiky. Výběr karty ověř v jeho diagnostice nebo ve Správci úloh.

start.timingScope: Inclusive CPU API calls (nested scopes overlap); async durations are completion latency, not GPU execution time

shaderInventory.scope: Per-device successful module calls; exact text equality confirms duplicates. Body identity only from observed pinned WGSL prefix construction. Unknown/limited calls are not evidence of uniqueness.
shaderInventory.overheadScope: Text capture/setStage CPU only; nested inside engine timings. Hook entry/cleanup and snapshot/serialization excluded. Text limit counts retained UTF-16 code units (raw plus pending provenance), not total JavaScript heap. Diagnostic overhead, not a performance improvement.

unusedDefines.scope: Observed owned convert/post/finalize provenance; exact derived equality omits only unreferenced generated uppercase non-reserved bool/small decimal-int declarations. Newlines and all other text remain. Candidate only, not semantic equivalence or a runtime/cache change. Counts per analyzed module call; names per distinct analyzed raw text.

sharedCacheCounters.scope: Babylon static counters shared by all engines in this JavaScript realm

engineCpuBreakdownScope.activeMeshes: sum of Scene before/after active-mesh evaluation intervals in this frame
engineCpuBreakdownScope.mainDraw: sum of Scene before/after draw-phase intervals; excludes target draw callbacks and postprocess finalization
engineCpuBreakdownScope.renderTargets: sum of every ObjectRenderer init/finish interval, including multiple targets and repeated passes
engineCpuBreakdownScope.relationship: nested in frameBreakdownMs.render; inclusive intervals can overlap each other and must not be added as a whole-frame total
engineCpuBreakdownScope.incompleteIntervals: unpaired intervals interrupted by renderer removal or frame termination are not counted
